sections.content: Passive voice keeps the territory or the principle as the grammatical subject, letting a sentence trace what happened to a border or a legal rule without stopping to name every government involved. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: Fue adoptado por la mayoría de las nuevas repúblicas un principio legal conocido como uti possidetis juris.
items.english: A legal principle known as uti possidetis juris was adopted by most of the new republics.

items.spanish: Ese principio fue aceptado formalmente por casi todos los gobiernos, pero resultó difícil de aplicar.
items.english: That principle was formally accepted by almost all governments, but proved hard to apply.

items.spanish: Las fronteras fueron discutidas, renegociadas y, en ocasiones, disputadas militarmente durante décadas.
items.english: Borders were discussed, renegotiated, and at times militarily disputed for decades.

items.spanish: La organización territorial interna de cada país fue modificada repetidamente.
items.english: Each country's internal territorial organization was repeatedly modified.

sections.content: Three passive verbs joined by commas (fueron discutidas, renegociadas y disputadas) let one sentence show escalation — a border problem didn't just get talked about, it kept getting talked about, then renegotiated, then in some cases fought over.
